description: Every external service sits behind an adapter in lib/integrations. Select implementations with env vars. Every adapter has a 'mock' implementation used locally and in tests (mock messages are viewable at /dev/messages; mock payments can be completed or failed from /dev/payments). Verify current API details against each provider's official documentation at implementation time; record any differences in docs/DECISIONS.md.

sms.notes: Use registered sender ID (SMS_SENDER_ID). Count segments (GSM-7 160 / UCS-2 70 chars) for cost units. Delivery reports via /api/webhooks/sms. IMPLEMENTED: arkesel (ARKESEL_API_KEY) and hubtel (HUBTEL_CLIENT_ID/HUBTEL_CLIENT_SECRET) in lib/integrations/messaging/ghana-sms.ts; select with MESSAGING_SMS_PROVIDER.

whatsapp.notes: Business-initiated messages must use approved templates (template_name + params). Free-form replies allowed inside the 24-hour customer service window. Verify webhook with WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN and X-Hub-Signature-256 using WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET. Webhook at /api/webhooks/whatsapp handles statuses and inbound messages (mileage replies).

email.notes: React Email templates with garage branding. Track opens/clicks only via our own link redirects (/l/[id]).

push.notes: VAPID keys; remove subscriptions that return 404/410.

MessagingProvider.link_tracking: All links in messages are short links /l/[shortId] that record clicked_at on reminder_messages/message_log then redirect to the magic link.
MessagingProvider.platform_sms: lib/messaging/direct.ts sendDirectSms(): platform transactional SMS (sign-in codes, broker notifications). Bypasses garage quiet hours and garage message allowances. Templates: otp, broker_request_new, broker_quote_ready, broker_request_update, broker_request_reply.

interface.initializeCardOrMomoCheckout({ amountPes: Hosted checkout supporting card and mobile money
interface.chargeMobileMoney({ amountPesewas, phone: Direct MoMo prompt to the customer's phone
interface.verify(reference) -> { status, amountPes: Always verify server-side before marking paid
interface.parseWebhook(req) -> event: Verify x-paystack-signature (HMAC SHA512 of raw body with secret key)

webhook.idempotency: Insert into webhook_events (provider, event_id) first; skip if exists.

PaymentProvider.metadata: Always include garage_id, branch_id, entity_type (invoice|estimate_deposit|instalment|credit_account|vendor_order|subscription|message_bundle), entity_id

theteller.status: GET /v1.1/users/transactions/{transaction_id}/status — no webhooks: confirm after redirect AND poll pending txns via Inngest.
theteller.auth: HTTP Basic base64(apiuser:apikey); status call uses Merchant-Id header
theteller.collect: Hosted checkout POST checkout.theteller.net/initiate (test: test.theteller.net/checkout/initiate) or MoMo direct debit POST /v1.1/transaction/process processing_code 000200, r-switch MTN|VDF|ATL. amount = 12-char zero-padded minor units; transaction_id = 12-digit unique numeric.
theteller.payout: Float transfer: MoMo processing_code 404000, r-switch FLT, account_issuer MTN|VDF|ATL|…; bank 404020 (account_issuer GIP, account_bank code) → confirm name → POST /v1.1/transaction/bank/ftc/authorize.
theteller.notes: No split payments — commission/fees handled in FixAm ledger (escrow_holds, payouts).
theteller.status_built: Built in P8-02: lib/integrations/payments/theteller.ts (collections + PayoutProvider), redirect handler /api/payments/return/{ref}/{b64path}, Inngest payments-pending-poller (*/5), payout-on-queued, payouts-sweep (*/10), escrow-auto-release (hourly). References from Postgres sequence payment_txn_seq.

StorageProvider.rules: Compress images client-side to max 1600px long edge, WebP, before upload. Serve private files via short-lived signed URLs (10 minutes).

interface.requestQuote(renewal) -> { status: 'pend: Manual: creates a staff task; staff enters the quote
interface.issuePolicy(renewal, payment) -> { statu: Manual: staff uploads policy and sticker

Auth.description: One Supabase account system for all roles.
Auth.phone_sign_in: lib/auth/phone-auth.ts: FixAm sends + verifies its own 6-digit code (portal_otps table, 10 min, 5 attempts, rate limited), then mints a Supabase session server-side (admin.generateLink magiclink → verifyOtp token_hash). New phone users get auth e-mail '<digits>@phone.fixam.app'; phone kept in auth.phone and/or app_metadata.phone (server-only — never trust user_metadata).
Auth.email: Supabase signInWithPassword / signUp on the client, then afterSignIn().
Auth.dev: With no SMS provider in non-production, the code is shown on screen.

AiProvider.interface: generateJson<T>({purpose, system, input, schema}) → T; logs ai_calls (tokens, cost).

SpeechProvider.notes: Khaya AI (GhanaNLP). Where Khaya lacks a translation pair, fall back to AiProvider.

interface.book({orderNumber, pickup, dropoff, note: Partner courier fallback; 'manual' SMSes DELIVERY_OPS_PHONE to book by hand

FinancingProvider.interface: apply({amount, months, customer, invoice}) → {ref, status}; status(ref); webhook(req)
FinancingProvider.notes: Partner lender to be chosen; garage paid up-front by partner.

WhatsAppProvider.notes: WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API; inbound webhook /api/webhooks/whatsapp (exists); templates required outside the 24 h customer-service window.

ObdBridge.notes: Client-side Web Bluetooth to ELM327-compatible BLE OBD-II dongles (AT/PID commands). Supported in Chromium browsers (Android, desktop); not in iOS Safari — native app later.

MapsProvider.notes: Distance/ETA for SOS, riders, pickup; live location via Supabase Realtime channels.

inngest_functions.trigger: cron '*/15 * * * *' (verify pending Paystack references older than 10 minutes)
cron '0 5 * * *' TZ=Africa/Accra (accounts whose statement_day is today)
cron '*/5 * * * *' — theTeller has no webhooks; reconcile pending references older than 2 min
cron '*/10 * * * *' (retries with backoff, confirms pending, alerts admin after 5 attempts)
